SELECT dp.uuid AS uuid, ds.name AS deptSub, dp.diagnosis AS diagnosis, dp.rp, pc.name AS patientName, pc.sex AS patientSex, DATE_FORMAT(pc.birthday, '%Y-%m-%d') AS patientBirthday, d.name AS doctorName FROM doctor_consultation_report dp JOIN doctor d ON d.id = dp.doctor_id JOIN patient_user_info pc ON pc.id = dp.patient_card_id JOIN medical_dept_sub ds ON ds.id = dp.sub_dept_id WHERE dp.registration_id = #{registrationId}
AND pc.user_id = #{userId}
